sources_quoted.source: docs/math-foundations.md lines 58-67 (Section 1.1, renewal theory for cast timing schedules)
sources_quoted.quote: Ability recasts are scheduled on **one shared timeline** (the champion has one set of hands): each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed *and* no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it *starts* within the window (`_schedule_shared_casts`). With `c_i` the effective cooldown of ability `i`, the cast epochs of a solo ability are `0, c_i, 2c_i, ...` - again a deterministic renewal schedule; the shared-timeline version is the superposition with mutual-exclusion, resolved greedily by cast order.

sources_quoted.why: establishes that a scenario 'cast order' is a 4-slot permutation (a priority order over Q/W/E/R), not an arbitrary-length literal cast script

independent_computation.step_1_castable_slots: Syndra's damaging, castable slots are Q, W, E, R (P Transcendent is a passive: 'Innate: Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath...'). A custom cast order for this scenario is therefore a permutation of those four slots.
independent_computation.step_2_opening_burst: Per math-foundations 1.1, every ability is off cooldown at t=0 and casts are 'resolved greedily by cast order', each occupying its sourced cast time (Q/W instant, E 0.25 s, R 0.25 s). So cast_timeline[0..3] are exactly the four slots in the scenario's custom order, all starting inside t in [0, ~0.5] s. cast_timeline[4] is therefore necessarily the FIRST RECAST, i.e. the ability whose effective cooldown elapses first.

step_3_effective_cooldowns.formula: cd' = cd * 100/(100 + AH)  (math-foundations line 462; CLAUDE.md domain rule 'effective_cd = base_cd x 100/(100 + ability_haste)')
step_3_effective_cooldowns.syndra_R_passive: R grants Dark Sphere (Q) an extra 10/20/30 ability haste by rank.
step_3_effective_cooldowns.monotone_proof_Q_beats_W_for_every_build: Q_eff < W_eff  <=>  7*100/(100+AH+h_R) < 8*100/(100+AH)  <=>  700 + 7*AH < 800 + 8*AH + 8*h_R, true for all AH >= 0, h_R >= 0. So Q is the first ability to come back up at any ability haste and at any W rank (W is 8-12 s base vs Q's flat 7 s).

independent_computation.step_4_conclusion: cast_timeline[4] = Q, cast at t ~= 5.4 s (no items, R3) or ~3.7 s at 60 AH. Q is the shortest-cooldown ability in Syndra's kit at every rank and every haste level, and her own R passive makes it shorter still.
step_5_why_R_is_impossible_at_index_4: (a) Documented model constraint, twice stated: 'R casts exactly once per timed fight' / 'R single-cast'. R therefore appears exactly once in the timeline, and since it is off cooldown at t=0 like everything else, that single appearance falls inside the opening burst at index 0-3 (its position in the custom order).

(b) Even ignoring (a), R's cooldown is 80 s at rank 3 (100 s / 120 s at ranks 2 / 1), longer than a 60 s window; it only drops under 60 s at >33 AH, and even then a second R would land at t ~= 50-57 s, after roughly a dozen Q/W/E recasts - nowhere near index 4.
(c) There is no configuration of ranks, level, or ability haste in the cached data under which R's effective cooldown is the smallest of the four.

alternative_hypothesis_considered_and_re.hypothesis: cast_timeline[4] could legitimately be R if the opening burst contained FIVE casts before any recast - e.g. if Syndra's 40-splinter Transcendent bonus ('Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2', modelled per data/champion-audit/batch-e9-1.json as a 'Q2 slot') put a second stocked Q charge in the opening, shifting the order's last slot to index 4; or if 'custom order' were a literal arbitrary-length cast script such as Q,W,E,Q,R rather than a priority permutation.
why_rejected: The only cast_order value observable anywhere in the permitted evidence tree is a 4-slot permutation ('cast_order R,Q,W,E', data/champion-audit/batch-p1-3.json); nothing in data/ or docs/math-foundations.md documents repeat entries in a cast order.

docs/math-foundations.md - the sole permitted formula source - describes the schedule as a renewal superposition with cast epochs 0, c_i, 2c_i, ... 'resolved greedily by cast order', i.e. an ability fires as soon as it is up. That is a priority model, not a literal script, and it has no charge/ammo mechanic anywhere in Section 1.1 or in the formula-audit table.
Under the greedy model the fifth timeline entry is by construction a recast, and the recast identity (Q) is forced by the cooldown table with no free parameters.
alternative_hypothesis_considered_and_re.residual_uncertainty: The scenario's own input tuple (its cast order, level/ranks, items, and what '60' denotes - 60 s window, 60 ability haste, or 60 splinters) lives outside the permitted evidence tree (scripts/, tests/). The conclusion is invariant to level, ranks, items and haste, and invariant across every 4-slot permutation; it would only flip if the scenario's 'order' is a >4-entry literal cast script whose 5th entry is R, a form for which the permitted sources give no evidence.

notes: Aside (off-task, from the cached data): data/champions.json marks Syndra Q with affectedByCdr:false while her R passive text explicitly reduces Dark Sphere's cooldown 'equivalent to an amount of ability haste'. If any code path honours that flag literally, Q would sit at a flat 7 s and W (8 s at rank 5) would overtake it at roughly >26 ability haste (R1) / >49 (R3) - which would make cast_timeline[4] = W, not Q and not R. Worth a look; it does not change this verdict, since R is excluded either way.
